description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'SkillSearchFilterParams' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto'. It extends from a base class 'FilterParams' and encapsulates filtering parameters for searching skills, including allowed sorting fields, name, and description properties.

classes.name: SkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that holds search filter parameters specifically for skills, including name, description, and sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object by setting the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'description' filter parameter.
